title: work-state.json (schema 2) — F2
description: Canonical, self-contained snapshot of a Work. Authority over the Work's persisted state, including status and last_accessed_at (ADR-0013). Written only by the core, atomically (temp + rename). Plugins never read or write this file. Schema 2 is an additive superset of schema 1: status gains 'archived', archived_at is new (present iff archived), and last_accessed_at is now mutable. Readers accept schema 1 or 2; writers always emit 2 (see specs/001-first-local-work/contracts/work-state.schema.json for schema 1).

schema.description: Schema version. F2 emits 2. A schema-1 file (const 1, status only 'in-progress', no archived_at) is also a valid input.

work.description: Core-governed domain state. Plugins cannot create or write keys here.

id.description: Opaque, sortable, stable identity generated at creation (ULID). The only accepted form of an explicit command-line target for `work resume` / `work archive` (FR-026).

slug.description: Short human-readable identifier chosen by the user at creation. Not unique; the interactive picker disambiguates same-slug Works.

status.description: 'in-progress' is the resumable/active state. 'archived' means the worktree was destroyed and the snapshot relocated to <workspace>/archived/. F2 never transitions archived back to in-progress.

archived_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. Present if and only if status == 'archived'. Set once, at the archive commit.

start_mode.description: Unchanged from F1. 'contribution' / 'fork' arrive with F4.

starter.description: Logical name of the Starter that resolved the source. Unchanged from F1.

branch.description: The branch the Work created. Left intact in the source repository when the Work is archived (FR-014).

base_branch.description: Short name of the base ref the branch was started from. Unchanged from F1.

branch_convention.description: Resolved convention name. Unchanged from F1.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. Set once at creation; never rewritten by F2.

last_accessed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. Mutable in F2: bumped to 'now' on a successful `work resume`, and set to the archival time on `work archive`. Determines resume ordering (FR-003).

meta.description: Extensible metadata published by components. Empty in F2 (no plugins publish).

links.description: First-class external relations, one value per semantic key. Empty in F2.
